classifications.rationale: The President immediately revokes a prior memorandum governing internal executive succession, while preserving existing agency and OMB authorities. This is an internal administrative reorganization rather than a change to private legal rights or a mandated later agency legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: The Presidential Memorandum of February 1, 2013 (Designation of Officers of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation to Act as Director of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation), is hereby revoked.
